ma.onGyroscopeChange(function callback)

Listen for gyroscope data change events.

Parameter

function callback

Callback function for gyroscope data change events.

Sample Code

<view>
    <button size="default" type="primary" bindtap="start">Start Listening</button>
</view>

Page({
  listener(res) {
    console.log(res);
  },
  start() {
    ma.startGyroscope({
      success: () => {
        ma.onGyroscopeChange(this.listener);
      }
    });
  }
});
